x-recording.transport: in-process ASGI (httpx.ASGITransport) against create_app(), with ENABLE_LEARN_CONTENT=true. The learn endpoints read the repo-shipped content/ tree and touch neither Redis nor Postgres, so the body is a pure function of the committed manifests and is byte-identical through the Next.js /api proxy. `tests/test_contract_learn_fixtures.py` re-derives these bodies from the live app on every run, which is a stronger drift check than the recorded bytes alone. The `learn` phase in record.sh re-records them through the proxy for a reviewer who wants the full transport.
x-recording.stack: no containers: recorded in process with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=local-preview-disabled. The learn endpoints read repo-shipped files, open no backing store, and construct no model client.
